title: Introduce weighted fastpath lint proxy and lockfile-stamp for deterministic CI caching
author: Asha Kapoor
release_notes: Add fastpath presubmit routing to reduce lint latency on small PRs; introduce lockfile-stamp to make lockfile provenance verifiable and improve CI cache hit rate.
body:
Motivation: Our presubmit lanes still run a number of heavy language-specific linters and static analyzers on every PR which increases feedback latency and CI cost, especially for tiny changes (typo/docs/test tweak). This PR introduces a lightweight fastpath lint proxy that routes small/low-risk changes to a minimal lint set and only runs the full, heavy pipeline for larger/risky changes. In parallel, CI cache hit rates were suffering from spurious lockfile churn across toolchains. I implemented a deterministic lockfile-stamp generator and verifier to embed provenance metadata into a tiny, stable artifact that improves cache reuse across CI workers and makes lockfile changes auditable.

Summary of changes: 1) .github/actions/fastlint-proxy/action.yml — new composite GitHub Action implementing the routing logic (size heuristics + label overrides). 2) .github/workflows/presubmit.yml — wire up fastpath lanes, add a new presubmit.fastlint job that runs by default for small PRs, and a presubmit.full lint job that can be scheduled by weight or by label. 3) tools/lockfile-stamp/generate.go — small Go utility (single-file) that computes a canonical stamp (hash of lockfile + toolchain manifest) and emits stamp.txt; used in CI to validate lockfiles and warm caches. 4) scripts/ci/verify-lockfile.sh — verification step that fails CI if lockfile-stamp mismatches in strict mode (opt-in via PR label). 5) docs/ci/fastpath.md — explanation of heuristics, labels to opt-out/force full lint, and troubleshooting. 6) devcontainer/ — updates to developer image to include the stamp generator for local preflight. 7) Makefile — new target make ci-stamp for dev workflows.

Implementation notes: - Heuristic is intentionally conservative: files_changed_count < 10 and changes only in docs/, website/, examples/ go fastpath; otherwise weight is computed by language hit map and size. Labels: ci/force-full-lint and ci/fastpath-ok to override. - Routing action is pure YAML + small JS shim for parsing the PR patch (no cloud calls) so it can be reused in private deployments. - lockfile-stamp uses a stable serialization to compute a SHA256 of lockfile + toolchain-manifest; stamp format is 'v1|sha256|timestamp|toolchain-id' (timestamp included but not used for cache keys). CI uses stamp content and a deterministic artifact name to improve remote cache warm hits. - A small verification step is optional by default to avoid breaking existing flows; repo owners can enable strict verification via CODEOWNERS or a repo-level setting.

Testing and validation performed: - Unit tests for generator and parser (tools/lockfile-stamp/*_test.go) run in CI. - End-to-end presubmit simulation using a forked test harness (scripts/ci/simulate-fastpath.sh) with 120 synthetic PRs to validate routing decisions; averaged presubmit latency reduced by ~43% for small PRs in the synthetic run. - Staging rollout: flipped fastpath on for non-critical repo slices (examples, docs) for 48 hours before full rollout; no regressions observed.

Rollout plan: 1) Merge to main (this PR) with feature flag off. 2) Enable fastpath for docs and examples via repo config for 48h. 3) Monitor presubmit latency (goal: median < 3m for small PRs) and CI cost (goal: -20% compute for presubmit lane). 4) If stable, opt-in more languages by updating heuristics.

Rollback plan: remove ci/fastpath-ok label or flip feature gate; the fastlint proxy defaults to the conservative path (full-lint) if the action fails or is misconfigured, so rollback risk is low.

Files changed (high-level): - .github/actions/fastlint-proxy/action.yml (new) - .github/actions/fastlint-proxy/index.js (new, 120 LOC) - .github/workflows/presubmit.yml (modified) - tools/lockfile-stamp/generate.go (new) - scripts/ci/verify-lockfile.sh (new) - docs/ci/fastpath.md (new) - devcontainer/Dockerfile (modified) - Makefile (modified)

Commits: - 9f1d2be: add fastlint proxy action scaffold and JS shim - 3c4b2a7: wire fastpath into presubmit workflow and add labels - a7b5c3e: add lockfile-stamp generator + tests and CI verification step - d2e4f8b: docs and devcontainer updates + Makefile

Review thread (condensed): Maya Singh (reviewer): 'Nice approach — routing looks safe. Please make the weight thresholds config-driven (repo OR global default) and add a diag log when a PR is routed to full-lint so owners can reason about misses.'
Asha Kapoor (author): 'Added repo config option under .ci/config.yml and emit a short JSON diag log to artifacts/fastlint-routing.json; updated docs to mention location.'
Ethan Zhao (reviewer): 'Lockfile stamp generator looks good; can we avoid embedding timestamp in the stamp used for cache keys?'
Asha Kapoor: 'Timestamp is present for auditability but intentionally excluded from cache key computation. Clarified in the code and docs.'
Liam O'Connor (approver): 'Tests look solid. Recommend squashing commits and adding a short blurb in release notes.'

CI status and fixes: - Initial CI run failed (lint) because index.js used optional chaining not present in runner Node version; fixed by transpiling and pinned action runtime in action.yml. - Second run showed a flaky test in tools/lockfile-stamp on macOS runner (time zone sensitive test); converted to time-insensitive assertion. - Final CI run: all checks passing (unit tests, go vet, js lint, presubmit smoke job).

Outcomes: - Merged via squash. - Expected short-term impact: reduce median presubmit latency for small PRs by ~30-50% and reduce presubmit compute cost for the repo slice by ~18-25% (measured in staging). - Next steps: expose heuristics as UI toggles in console (ENG-4899), add telemetry to track routing accuracy, and extend stamp verification to dedicated/private installer flows.

Checklist: - [x] Adds new fastlint proxy action - [x] Adds deterministic lockfile-stamp generator + tests - [x] Updates presubmit workflow and docs - [x] Staging rollout validated - [x] Release notes entry added

Notes: This PR is intentionally conservative and opt-in. The fastpath proxy errs on the side of safety and defers to full lint when in doubt. The lockfile-stamp is lightweight and safe to add to existing pipelines; we've included a compatibility mode for older CI runners. If you hit issues, the docs/ci/fastpath.md has troubleshooting steps and a switch to force the full pipeline while investigating.
comment_summary: Maya requested config-driven thresholds and routing diagnostics; Ethan requested exclusion of timestamp from cache key; Liam approved after tests. Author addressed all comments and fixed Node version lint and a flaky test. CI passed on final run.
notes: Routing logs written to artifacts/fastlint-routing.json for first 7 days after rollout
stamp generator included in devcontainer for local preflight
